title.en: What makes a relation a function

body.en: A relation $f$ from $A$ to $B$ is a function if every element of $A$ has exactly one image in $B$. We write $f : A \to B$ and $y = f(x)$. $A$ is the domain, $B$ the codomain and $\{f(x) : x \in A\}$ the range. A real function has domain and range inside $R$.
body.kn: A ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶಕ್ಕೂ B ಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಆ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಫಲನ.

points.en: No element of A is left out
No element of A has two images
Two elements may share an image

narration.en: A relation is a function when every element of the domain has one and only one image. Two arrows from the same element, or a missing arrow, break the rule.
narration.kn: A ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶಕ್ಕೂ B ಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಆ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಫಲನ.

narration.en: A function sends every input to exactly one output.

say.en: A function sends every input to exactly one output.

title.en: Finding the domain of a real function

body.en: If no domain is given, take the largest set of real $x$ for which $f(x)$ is a real number. Exclude values that make a denominator zero, and keep expressions under an even root $\ge 0$.
body.kn: ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಛೇದವನ್ನು ಶೂನ್ಯ ಮಾಡುವ ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು, ವರ್ಗಮೂಲದೊಳಗಿನದು ಶೂನ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಧನವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು.

narration.en: To find the domain, remove the values that make a denominator zero and keep whatever is under a square root greater than or equal to zero.
